abi: accepted M1a resident noise_refiner.0 ABI, unchanged

input.storage: BF16 accepted at boundary then expanded to FP32

timestep.storage: BF16 accepted at boundary then expanded to FP32

execution: A input is FP32-normalized and modulated; QKV writes C
C is viewed as contiguous Q, K, V [1024,30,128]; normalize/rope Q and K only
attention uses per-head [1024] FP32 logits/probabilities and writes B
attention projection writes C prefix; RMSNorm2 and attention gate write B residual
FFN norm/modulation reads B; W1 writes C and W3 writes D; SiLU(W1)*W3 overwrites C
W2 writes A; FFN RMSNorm2 is in-place on A; MLP gate plus B residual writes final A
copy A to the resident output ABI only after final witness boundary
reduction_policy: fixed logical channel order, FP32 products and FP32 sums; stable softmax uses max then exp then FP32 sum; no adaptive reduction or model-specific fused oracle

initial_acceptance.canonical_cpu_bundle: all 34 stage payload SHA-256 values exact
initial_acceptance.gpu_reference_shader: compare selected canonical FP32 witness coordinates before permitting optimization; any disagreement is a fault requiring localization, not tolerance widening
